intro: The pleading face 🥺 is the internet's go-to symbol for 'pretty please' — big, watery, oversized eyes borrowed straight from puppy-dog-eyes body language, used to beg cutely, call something adorable, or land a playful guilt trip. It took off on TikTok and Twitter as the default reaction for asking a favor, softening a request, or responding to something so cute it hurts. This page gathers the full pleading family: the core begging and teary-eyed faces, soft puppy and animal faces that carry the same wide-eyed energy, hand gestures like 👉👈 that pair naturally with the look, related vulnerable and shy expressions, and classic begging kaomoji like (T_T) that paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for captions, comments, and DMs.
